Strict settlement merit, See, café-led Eat, all named trail providers, picnic, public visitor parking, public toilets, access, transport, dogs and complete local HES/NRHE construction dates were checked before continuing. East Pier Smokehouse and Craig Millar are meal-led and removed from Eat. Bowhouse and Baern are outside the strict village boundary.

touristAppeal.label: Strong Destination
touristAppeal.summary: St Monans remains a strong East Neuk visit for its harbour, Old Kirk, windmill and salt pans, tidal pool, Welly Boot Garden and coastal routes. The food list now concentrates on the two current café-led daytime choices.
touristAppeal.dogAccessSummary: The defining outdoor circuit is very good with a dog, but the kirk and both museums do not publish general pet admission, East Pier restricts dogs to its gazebo and outdoor seating, and longer walks require control around wildlife and farmland. Those restrictions reduce the score by five points.

visitorHighlights.name: St Monans Windmill and Saltpans
visitorHighlights.reason: Fife’s last salt-working windmill anchors an unusually legible coastal industrial landscape.
visitorHighlights.openingTimes: Exterior and saltpans open in daylight; windmill interior closed until further notice.

editorialReview.scoreRationale: Highly distinctive and well interpreted, reduced for the closed interior.

visitorHighlights.name: St Monans Auld Kirk
visitorHighlights.reason: A medieval kirk in one of Scotland’s most dramatic shore-side settings, now entering community stewardship.
visitorHighlights.openingTimes: Exterior and graveyard in daylight; interior on advertised open days, weekends and events.

editorialReview.scoreRationale: Exceptional setting and strong fabric, reduced for irregular interior access during refurbishment.

visitorHighlights.name: St Monans Working Harbour and Tidal Pool
visitorHighlights.reason: A rewarding working-waterfront circuit with historic piers, seafood and a restored tidal pool.
visitorHighlights.openingTimes: Open-air public waterfront; daylight recommended. Pool is tidal and unsupervised.

editorialReview.scoreRationale: Authentic and coherent harbour experience, reduced for operational hazards and an unsupervised tidal pool.

townGuide.headline: Three exceptional coastal landmarks in one walkable village
townGuide.intro: St Monans remains a strong East Neuk visit for its harbour, Old Kirk, windmill and salt pans, tidal pool, Welly Boot Garden and coastal routes. The food list now concentrates on the two current café-led daytime choices.
perfectFor: A rich half-day East Neuk visit
Visitors who prefer compact places explored on foot

suggestedFirstVisit.title: Walk the full historic shore
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Begin at the Auld Kirk, cross the working harbour and tidal pool, then follow the coast to the windmill and saltpans before returning through the village.

dontMiss: St Monans Working Harbour and Tidal Pool
townGuide.suggestedTime: 4–6 hours; a full day with a long circular walk
townGuide.visitorMood: A small place with an unusually complete coastal story: medieval faith, fishing, engineering, salt-making and contemporary food all sit within one continuous shore walk.
